NAME
  sprint workflows states save — Workflow settings use current team revision; scoped templates and label groups enforce current permissions.

SYNOPSIS
  sprint workflows states save --json-data OBJECT | --file PATH --expected-revision REVISION [FLAGS]

DESCRIPTION
  Workflow settings use current team revision; scoped templates and label groups enforce current permissions.

EXAMPLES
  sprint workflows states save --file input.json --expected-revision REVISION

POSITIONAL ARGUMENTS
  None; see SYNOPSIS for required input flags.

FLAGS
  --expected-revision REVISION (required; see SYNOPSIS)
  --non-interactive
  --json-data OBJECT | --file PATH

  --wait                     Observe an accepted job without retrying the mutation.
  --timeout SECONDS          Wait timeout, 1..3600; requires --wait (default: 30).

OUTPUT
  output data on stdout; errors on stderr.
